title: Lab and Research Technician 1, Department of Neuroscience

cond_0001.intro:
The [Company name masked] in the Department of Neuroscience and the Center of Brain Immunology and Glia (BIG) is seeking to hire a motivated and detail-oriented Lab and Research Technician 1 to perform and assist with animal colony management and experimental procedures. The lab is investigating the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
The incumbent will be responsible for managing the lab's animal colony, assisting in animal experiments, maintaining lab equipment, and helping to train undergraduate students.
Lab and Research Technician 1 employees focus on performing routine research tasks and developing skills. They assume routine to moderately complex technical support for research projects. Work is routine and can be performed with some degree of independence when following established protocols and procedures. Lab and Research Technician 1 employees perform tasks as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Perform similar duties to Lab and Research Aide, such as collecting specimens, setting up and performing experiments of a repetitive nature; and preparing culture media, chemicals, reagents, and solutions as instructed. At direction of Principal Investigator or senior staff, perform biological, hematological, chemical, or physical analysis. Participate in research or clinical work involving treatment operations and experiments with animals to include care and feeding, cage cleaning and sanitization, and observation during post-operative or treatment periods. May perform some surgical procedures on small lab animals. Prepare support materials, compare, and assist with analyses of data and write reports. Assist with literature reviews. Operate, adjust, and maintain specific scientific apparatuses and instruments. Order lab supplies and maintain inventory. Record accurate information and logs of experimental data. Keep informed of new lab techniques. Provide routine, technical, and administrative support to research projects. May contact and coordinate schedules with study subjects, handle information intake, and record and track results. May provide logistical support to the study. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent.
At least one year of lab experience, which may include student experience.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree (will also be considered in lieu of experience).
Motivated to learn new laboratory techniques and skills.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

The lab is investigating the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
This role focuses on performing routine research tasks and developing skills, with responsibility for technical support across research projects. Work is routine to moderately complex and can be carried out with some independence when following established protocols. Tasks are assigned by a supervisor.
cond_0044.responsibilities:
Collect specimens, set up and perform experiments of a repetitive nature, and prepare culture media, chemicals, reagents, and solutions as instructed.
At the direction of the Principal Investigator or senior staff, execute biological, hematological, chemical, or physical analyses.
Lead day-to-day animal colony management, including care and feeding, cage cleaning and sanitization, and observation during post-operative or treatment periods. May perform some surgical procedures on small lab animals.
Prepare support materials, drive analyses of data, and produce written reports.
Conduct literature reviews.
Operate, adjust, and maintain specific scientific apparatuses and instruments.
Own lab supply ordering and inventory management.
Record accurate experimental data and maintain detailed logs.
Stay current on new lab techniques.
Deliver routine technical and administrative support to research projects.
May directly coordinate schedules with study subjects, handle information intake, and track results. May provide logistical support to the study.
Other duties may be assigned.
cond_0044.requirements:
Minimum Requirements**
High school diploma or equivalent.
At least one year of lab experience, which may include student experience.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Preferred Requirements**
Bachelor's degree (will be considered in lieu of experience).
Motivated to learn new laboratory techniques and skills.
Strong problem-solving skills.

The lab investigates the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
In this role, you will work alongside the team on animal colony management and experimental procedures, help maintain lab equipment, and support the training of undergraduate students.
Lab and Research Technician 1 employees focus on performing routine research tasks and developing skills. They share responsibility for routine to moderately complex technical support on research projects. Work is routine and can be performed with some degree of independence when following established protocols and procedures. Tasks are assigned by a supervisor.
cond_0315.responsibilities:
Work alongside lab staff to collect specimens, set up and perform experiments of a repetitive nature, and prepare culture media, chemicals, reagents, and solutions as instructed.
At the direction of the Principal Investigator or senior staff, assist with biological, hematological, chemical, or physical analysis.
Participate in research or clinical work involving treatment operations and experiments with animals, including care and feeding, cage cleaning and sanitization, and observation during post-operative or treatment periods.
May assist with some surgical procedures on small lab animals.
Help prepare support materials, assist with data analyses, and contribute to writing reports.
Support literature reviews.
Operate, adjust, and maintain specific scientific apparatuses and instruments.
Coordinate with team members to order lab supplies and maintain inventory.
Record accurate information and logs of experimental data.
Keep informed of new lab techniques.
Provide routine technical and administrative support to research projects.
May help coordinate schedules with study subjects, handle information intake, and record and track results.
May provide logistical support to the study.
Other duties may be assigned.
cond_0315.requirements:
Minimum Requirements**
High school diploma or equivalent
At least one year of lab experience, which may include student experience
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Preferred Requirements**
Bachelor's degree (will be considered in lieu of experience)
Motivation to learn new laboratory techniques and skills
Strong problem-solving skills
cond_0315.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.
cond_0315.workplace_support: We foster connection and community through employee groups and inclusive workplace initiatives so people can bring their full selves to work and find support across different identities and life experiences.

The lab is investigating the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
The incumbent will be responsible for managing the lab's animal colony, assisting in animal experiments, maintaining lab equipment, and helping to train undergraduate students.
Lab and Research Technician 1 employees focus on performing routine research tasks and developing skills. They assume routine to moderately complex technical support for research projects. Work is routine and can be performed with some degree of independence when following established protocols and procedures. Lab and Research Technician 1 employees perform tasks as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0397.responsibilities: Perform similar duties to Lab and Research Aide, such as collecting specimens, setting up and performing experiments of a repetitive nature; and preparing culture media, chemicals, reagents, and solutions as instructed. At direction of Principal Investigator or senior staff, perform biological, hematological, chemical, or physical analysis. Participate in research or clinical work involving treatment operations and experiments with animals to include care and feeding, cage cleaning and sanitization, and observation during post-operative or treatment periods. May perform some surgical procedures on small lab animals. Prepare support materials, compare, and assist with analyses of data and write reports. Assist with literature reviews. Operate, adjust, and maintain specific scientific apparatuses and instruments. Order lab supplies and maintain inventory. Record accurate information and logs of experimental data. Keep informed of new lab techniques. Provide routine, technical, and administrative support to research projects. May contact and coordinate schedules with study subjects, handle information intake, and record and track results. May provide logistical support to the study. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0397.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent.
At least one year of lab experience, which may include student experience.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree (will also be considered in lieu of experience).
Motivated to learn new laboratory techniques and skills.
cond_0397.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0397.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

The lab studies the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
The role involves managing the lab's animal colony, assisting in animal experiments, maintaining lab equipment, and regularly working with and helping to train undergraduate students.
Lab and Research Technician 1 employees focus on performing routine research tasks and developing skills. They provide routine to moderately complex technical support for research projects. Work is routine and can be performed with some degree of independence when following established protocols and procedures. Tasks are assigned by a supervisor.
cond_0519.responsibilities: Perform similar duties to Lab and Research Aide, such as collecting specimens, setting up and performing experiments of a repetitive nature, and preparing culture media, chemicals, reagents, and solutions as instructed. At direction of Principal Investigator or senior staff, perform biological, hematological, chemical, or physical analysis. Participate in research or clinical work involving treatment operations and experiments with animals, including care and feeding, cage cleaning and sanitization, and observation during post-operative or treatment periods. May perform some surgical procedures on small lab animals. Prepare support materials, compare, and assist with analyses of data and write reports. Assist with literature reviews. Operate, adjust, and maintain specific scientific apparatuses and instruments. Order lab supplies and maintain inventory. Record accurate information and logs of experimental data. Stay informed of new lab techniques. Provide routine, technical, and administrative support to research projects. May regularly contact and coordinate schedules with study subjects, handle information intake, and record and track results. May provide logistical support to the study. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0519.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent. A Bachelor's degree is preferred.
At least one year of lab experience, which may include student experience. Bachelor's degree will be considered in lieu of experience.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Motivated to learn new laboratory techniques and skills.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
